spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: Tiamat can innately cast the following spell, her spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 26):

traits.name: Discorporation
traits.descriptionHtml: When Tiamat drops to 0 hit points or dies, her body is destroyed but her essence travels back to her domain in the Nine Hells, and she is unable to take physical form for a time.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (5/Day)
traits.descriptionHtml: If Tiamat fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Limited Magic Immunity
traits.descriptionHtml: Unless she wishes to be affected, Tiamat is immune to spells of 6th level or lower. She has advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.descriptionHtml: Tiamat's weapon attacks are magical.

traits.name: Multiple Heads
traits.descriptionHtml: Tiamat can take one reaction per turn, rather than only one per round. She also has advantage on saving throws against being knocked unconscious. If she fails a saving throw against an effect that would stun a creature, one of her unspent legendary actions is spent.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.descriptionHtml: Tiamat regains 30 hit points at the start of her turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.descriptionHtml: Tiamat can use her Frightful Presence. She then makes three attacks: two with her claws and one with her tail.

actions.name: Claw
actions.descriptionHtml: mw +19 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}24 (4d6 + 10) slashing damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.descriptionHtml: mw +19 to hit, reach 25 ft., one target. {@h}28 (4d8 + 10) piercing damage.

actions.name: Frightful Presence
actions.descriptionHtml: Each creature of Tiamat's choice that is within 240 feet of Tiamat and aware of her must succeed on a DC 26 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to Tiamat's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.

legendaryActions.description:
Tiamat can take 5 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. Tiamat regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.
Tiamat's legendary action options are associated with her five dragon heads (a bite and a breath weapon for each). Once Tiamat chooses a legendary action option for one of her heads, she can't choose another one associated with that head until the start of her next turn.

entries.name: Bite
entries.descriptionHtml: mw +19 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. {@h}32 (4d10 + 10) slashing damage plus 14 (4d6) acid damage (black dragon head), lightning damage (blue dragon head), poison damage (green dragon head), fire damage (red dragon head), or cold damage (white dragon head).

entries.name: Black Dragon Head: Acid Breath (Costs 2 Actions)
entries.descriptionHtml: Tiamat breathes acid in a 120-foot line that is 10 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a DC 27 Dexterity saving throw, taking 67 (15d8) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

entries.name: Blue Dragon Head: Lightning Breath (Costs 2 Actions)
entries.descriptionHtml: Tiamat breathes lightning in a 120-foot line that is 10 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a DC 27 Dexterity saving throw, taking 88 (16d10) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

entries.name: Green Dragon Head: Poison Breath (Costs 2 Actions)
entries.descriptionHtml: Tiamat breathes poisonous gas in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 27 Constitution saving throw, taking 77 (22d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

entries.name: Red Dragon Head: Fire Breath (Costs 2 Actions)
entries.descriptionHtml: Tiamat breathes fire in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 27 Dexterity saving throw, taking 91 (26d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

entries.name: White Dragon Head: Cold Breath (Costs 2 Actions)
entries.descriptionHtml: Tiamat breathes an icy blast in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 27 Dexterity saving throw, taking 72 (16d8) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

traits.name: Dragon Fanatic
traits.descriptionHtml: The dragonsoul has advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened. While the dragonsoul can see a dragon or higher-ranking Cult of the Dragon cultist friendly to it, the dragonsoul ignores the effects of being charmed or frightened.

traits.name: Fanatic Advantage
traits.descriptionHtml: Once per turn, if the dragonsoul makes a weapon attack with advantage on the attack roll and hits, the target takes an extra 10 (3d6) damage.

traits.name: Limited Flight
traits.descriptionHtml: The dragonsoul can use a bonus action to gain a flying speed of 30 feet until the end of its turn.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.descriptionHtml: The dragonsoul has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the dragonsoul's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.descriptionHtml: The Dragonsoul attacks twice with its shortsword.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.descriptionHtml: mw +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) damage of the type to which the dragonsoul has resistance.

actions.name: Orb of Dragon's Breath (3/Day)
actions.descriptionHtml: rs +7 to hit, range 90 ft., one target. {@h}27 (6d8) damage of the type to which the dragonsoul has damage resistance.
